description: Passengers (scripts/passengers.gd): the beds they sleep in and what each pays, the long-haul parties at the freight office, what a rough or late trip costs, and what they say. Local passengers are asked for in person (people.json, passenger). See docs/runtime/passengers.md.

long: Passage to %s, if you're going. We pack light and complain quietly.
My sister's in %s and she won't come to me. So.
I need to be in %s. I'm told your ship mostly arrives.
Contract work in %s. The company pays the fare, so I'd like the good bed.
cabin: We'd want a cabin. A door that shuts. We've done the bunk thing; we're past the bunk thing.
A cabin, please. I'm not sleeping where your engineer sleeps.
stateroom: A stateroom, naturally. I don't ask the price, so please don't tell me it.
The stateroom. And the viewport had better have stars in it.

bunk: Is this someone's bunk? It smells like someone's bunk.
I've slept in worse. Not recently.
The pillow has a name on it. It isn't mine.
cabin: Small, but the door locks. I've paid more for worse.
The viewport's the size of a plate. A nice plate.
We're fine. Are we nearly there? We're fine.
quarters: The lounge has a screen. It shows the same three films.
Someone's snoring in pod two. It's not me. It's never me.
Nice enough. The curtains don't quite meet.
stateroom: I asked for a window and got a window. Remarkable.
The plant's real. I checked. I always check.
Tell the captain the sheets are adequate. High praise.
late: I've started counting the rivets. There are a lot of rivets.

bunk: This bunk was built for a lighter people. I will manage.
A crew bunk. It is clean. That is what matters.
Someone keeps this bunk well. I can tell.
cabin: The cabin is small, but the door is solid. I approve of the door.
The viewport is small. The frame around it is good.
We are on schedule? Good. I do not need to be told twice.
quarters: The lounge furniture would not survive my homeworld.
Someone in pod two is snoring. It is not me. We do not snore.
Adequate. The fittings are light, but adequate.
stateroom: I asked for a window. There is a window. This ship keeps its word.
The plant is real. Someone waters it. That is care.
Tell the captain the stateroom is well kept. That is high praise.
late: We were promised arrival by now. A promise is a load.
I have counted the rivets. They are sound. We are still late.

bunk: Crew bunk. Efficient. Smells of someone.
Personal items: not mine. Mass: unnecessary.
cabin: Are we on schedule? Checking. Yes. Good.
quarters: Three films in the lounge. Ninety megabytes of redundancy.
Curtains overlap by minus two centimetres. Noted.
stateroom: The plant is real. Seventeen grams of soil. Unnecessary. Pleasant.
Tell the captain: the sheets are within tolerance.
late: We are late. By my count, eleven hours.
Rivets counted. Four hundred and twelve. Still late.

bunk: Someone sleeps here usually. I can feel them.
It's dry in here. So dry. I'll manage.
Somebody's name is on the pillow. I'll keep it warm for them.
cabin: It's small, but it's ours. Mine. For now.
The air's a little dry. Could someone mist it?
We're fine. Are we nearly there? We're fine.
quarters: The lounge has a screen and three films. We've all watched them together.
Someone in pod two is snoring. It's soothing, honestly.
The curtains don't quite meet. Nothing ever quite does.
stateroom: A window. I can watch the stars drift by. Like water.
The plant's real. I checked. It's thirsty.
Tell the captain the room is lovely. And a little dry.
late: We were meant to be there by now. The tide waits for no one.
We're late. Everyone at home is waiting. They'll understand.

bunk: This is someone's bunk. We like it. It smells like a home.
We have slept in worse. With more of us.
The pillow has a name on it. We will share.
cabin: The door locks. We do not know why you would want that.
A small cabin. Cosy. Could fit four of us.
We are fine. Are we nearly there? We are fine.
quarters: The lounge is the best room. Everyone is in it.
Someone in pod two is snoring. We find it comforting.
The curtains do not meet. Good. We like to see who is there.
stateroom: A room for one. We feel lonely. It is very nice.
The plant is real. We have named it.
Tell the captain the stateroom is big enough for a family. Ours.
late: We were promised arrival by now. We are all disappointed together.
We have counted the rivets. All of us. We disagree on the number.
